technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with short-term momentum (RSI, Hull, three white soldiers) offset by weak intermediate trend structure (below 50-day MAs, below cloud) and low ADX; moderate swing entry with elevated overbought risk.

fundamental.summary: ALLE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 23 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional purchases are modest and dated (155+ days old), providing weak confirmation; no recent news sentiment available to validate setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (310+) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 23 days adds event risk; ALLE faces hostile trading environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, three white soldiers, and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) create short-term momentum setup with contrarian appeal near support at 86.45.
debate.key_bear_argument: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, earnings event risk in 23 days, price below all key moving averages, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a hostile macro environment with insufficient edge.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (Hull flip, three white soldiers) and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) create contrarian appeal, but this is overwhelmed by inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, earnings event risk in 23 days, and price below all key moving averages with zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 23 days combined with macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, VIX 310+) creates uncompensated event and systemic risk; price below 50-day MAs and cloud indicates weak intermediate trend structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro environment and insufficient fundamental/smart money support overriding short-term technicals
